title: Close the sim-lease and sim-test gaps the Mac sim gatekeeper found
why: Owner ask ask-mw6q8p58kl, 12:18 CST Nov 7: commit b7bc81da (branch claude/sim-lease-592a4d, docs/plans/sim-lease-gaps.md) records issues the Mac had in sharing iOS simulators. Worst: a reuse takes no lease, so a Home design review and a Degen test drove Duo 1 at once on Nov 7 (7 lost tries); two runs held Duo 1 at once in spite of the Mac lock; a stopped run leaves Duo 1 in Dark appearance.
note: Seven gaps, worst first, in the plan file. Gaps 1-3: a test red on main first, then the fix; sim-lease status names whoever uses each booted phone, reuse included. Gaps 4-7 (load bar, slot 2, priority and silent-holder limit, a lane with no coordinator): one record each with its measure, or an owner question where the fix departs from a ruling. Ask the owner before any erase of a shared device or change to a runtime or Xcode. The plan's branch opens no PR; the lane starts from main. Until fixed, the Mac gatekeeper hands out each Duo run by chat. Owner note (ask-mw6qavsj7e, 12:20 CST Nov 7): on the Mac, the lease today spawns a real session, so when the session at the head of the line is busy it is skipped and the phone goes to the next in line. Mechanize that skip in the tool, so it holds without a gatekeeper session. Lane started 12:42 CST Nov 7. Owner question: item 336 (rewrite sim-lease-tool ruling 4 so a reuse takes the lease). Coordinator picks, process-only, can be undone: a booted Duo that is not a slot is leased as slot "other"; each run start resets to Light and fold closed, apps never removed; first-come order with a 1800 s silent-holder limit (unmeasured). Slot 2 stays: decided by the owner in sim-lease-tool (2026-11-02 14:23 CST). Nothing goes to runner 8 until item 336 is answered. Owner picked 336 a at 12:31 CST: ruling 4 of sim-lease-tool is rewritten, a reuse takes the lease. Coordinator pick, 13:41 CST Nov 7 (undoable): rewrite record sim-test-is-the-one-boot-path ruling 1, so the Mac lock is held only while a run picks and boots. The owner's 2026-11-02 14:23 CST two-Duo ruling covers it. Kept doing on: #1599 open draft (claude/sim-lease-gaps) (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 06:03 CST Nov 10). Fold (12:21 CST Nov 10, outbox sweep, owner pick 493 a): home roadmap step sim-lock (2bbe917): add the coordinator-forced takeover, not named here yet. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane:-sim-lease-gaps]). Lane code-decisions started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
